verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents importing and exporting realms as JSON files, automating realm import via the operator, and scripted user management through the Admin CLI, Admin REST API and SCIM endpoints, so bulk user movement in and out is plausible. A custom user-storage provider can also front existing user stores such as a relational database. The evidence never states that realm exports include users or that password hashes can be imported or exported, which is the core of the lock-in concern. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that users and their password hashes are included in import/export, details on supported hash algorithms, and hands-on corroboration of a migration round-trip.
